name: 01-krypton
title: Krypton Desk
blurb: Modelled on kryptonairc-lc.github.io/KRYPTONV2 — near-black green ground, mint accent, serif display, left sidebar.

name: 02-frost
title: Frost Desk
blurb: Soft frosted surfaces on a cool blue-grey ground, cobalt accent, big readouts and floating controls.

name: 03-amber
title: Amber Tape
blurb: A softened terminal — charcoal ground, amber accent, monospace throughout, full-width rows instead of cards.

name: 04-swiss
title: Swiss Tape
blurb: International-style grid — white ground, black type, one cobalt, rules instead of boxes, oversized figures.

name: 05-nordic
title: Nordic Dusk
blurb: Deep navy ground, ice-cyan accent, an icon rail on the left, hairlines and generous gutters.

name: 06-bento
title: Bento Desk
blurb: Lavender-grey ground with softly tinted tiles — each surface a bento tray, pill segment tabs, rounded and airy.

name: 07-notebook
title: Field Ledger
blurb: An analyst's ruled notebook — ivory paper, slab headings, teal ink, index-tab navigation and margin notes.

name: 08-oled
title: Violet Signal
blurb: True-black OLED ground with a violet glow accent, the chart as the hero, centered nav, luminous lines.

name: 09-dataink
title: Morning Sheet
blurb: Tufte-quiet — white paper, one cobalt, serif prose with sans data; reads like the morning sheet with a sticky contents rail.

name: 10-brass
title: Brass & Espresso
blurb: Warm dark espresso ground with a brass accent, Lora headings over Karla, cards lit from the top edge.
